_comment: The §64 model registry. Every prediction stores which version made it,
so a field can always be traced to the model that produced it.
scripts/seed_demo.py loads this into the model_versions table.

versions.name: ocr-v1
versions.notes: Pretrained. §66 says do not fine-tune before measuring.

versions.name: layout-v1
versions.notes: Baseline. LayoutLMv3 is wired behind the same interface but not trained.

versions.name: extractor-v1
versions.description: Deterministic rules over OCR blocks, with optional IndicBERT assist
versions.notes: Rules first (§7). Explainable, and it can say why it chose a value.

versions.name: confidence-v1
versions.description: Weighted fusion of OCR, extraction, layout and validation signals
versions.notes: Not calibrated. ECE and reliability diagrams are §65 work not yet done.

versions.name: anomaly-v1
versions.description: Deterministic history rules plus an Isolation Forest over 10 features
versions.notes: The forest is fitted on the corpus at analysis time, not shipped as a checkpoint.
